known.section: Research, Decisions, decision 7(a) (line 31); Steps, row 3 plan_helper_round_trips (line 54)
known.summary: separate body, label, and claim mutations break the contract's same-write claim: GraphQL runs them serially with partial success, so the body can change while the later claim fails and leaves a modified, unassigned plan (the body and the claim belong in one updateIssue mutation; replacing labels through labelIds was rejected)
step 3 changes the shipped plan.mjs, which requires bumping metadata.updated in plan-manager/SKILL.md, but that file is in no step's Files

known.summary: the plan moves the body from gh issue edit --body-file into a gh api graphql variable without saying how; the helper's graphql() passes values with -F, which fills {owner}/{repo}/{branch} placeholders and converts types, so a body that quotes such a token is stored rewritten
